import java.util.*;
public class OrderService { public static List<Order> query(List<Order> orders,String status,int page,int size){if(page<0||size<=0)throw new IllegalArgumentException();var filtered=orders.stream().filter(o->status==null||status.isBlank()||status.equals(o.status())).toList();long from=(long)page*size;if(from>=filtered.size())return List.of();return filtered.subList((int)from,(int)Math.min(from+size,filtered.size()));} }
